I searched Mathlib for `tateLaurent`, `TateCurve` and `tateToricPoint` and got no hits; Mathlib has no Tate curve. Its only Mathlib ingredients are general tools, such as injectivity of the map into the fraction field and `map_equation` for Weierstrass curves. None of them carries the theorem's content.
